join.title: Join the app beta
join.description: Beta app builds arrive days or weeks before the store release. This is separate from the server switch above.
join.iosInstructions: Install Apple's free TestFlight app from the App Store, then open the invite below and tap Accept, then Install. TestFlight tells you whenever a new beta build is ready.
join.androidInstructions: Open the invite below while signed in to Google Play with the account you use for Pokebattler, tap Become a tester, then update Pokebattler from the Play Store. Play then keeps you on beta builds automatically.
